notes: Hashes for WRDS-derived CRSP daily returns used by smoke and evaluation runs.

data/returns_daily.csv.note: CRSP daily returns ingested via src/io/crsp_daily.py with default filters; tickers aligned to WRDS canonical names.

data/returns_sample.csv.note: Small sample returns for smoke runs; copied from reports/rc-20251103/sample_returns.csv.

data/returns_sample_spike.csv.note: Sample returns with injected spikes in ETF0 (+0.2) on 2024-01-16, 2024-02-13, 2024-03-12, 2024-04-09, 2024-05-07 for overlay validation.

data/returns_daily_2022_2024.csv.note: Subset of data/returns_daily.csv filtered to 2022-01-03 through 2024-06-28 for uncapped smoke runs.

data/returns_daily_2018_2019.csv.note: Subset of data/returns_daily.csv filtered to 2018-01-02 through 2019-12-31 for uncapped smoke runs.
